parameters.name: AcrRegistryInfo
parameters.description: The information about the ACR instance. For more information, see [Use a password-free method to pull images from an ACR repository](~~194250~~).

sub_parameters.name: ArnService
sub_parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role that belongs to the account of the resource, such as an ECI instance.

sub_parameters.name: ArnUser
sub_parameters.description: The ARN of the RAM role that belongs to the account of the ACR instance.

sub_parameters.name: Domain
sub_parameters.description: The domain names of the ACR Enterprise instance. By default, all domain names of the instance are specified. You can specify one or more domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the ACR Enterprise instance.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the ACR Enterprise instance.

sub_parameters.name: RegionId
sub_parameters.description: The region where the ACR Enterprise instance resides.

parameters.name: Annotations
parameters.description: The annotations. This parameter is not for external use.

parameters.name: AutoMatchImageCache
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable image cache reuse. If you enable this feature, new image caches can reuse the image layers of existing image caches. This speeds up the creation of image caches. Valid values:

- true

- false

Default value: false.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: EipInstanceId
parameters.description: The EIP. To pull images from the Internet, make sure that the ECI instance can access the Internet. To enable Internet access, configure an EIP or a NAT Gateway.

parameters.name: EliminationStrategy
parameters.description:
The eviction policy of the image cache. The default value is empty, which indicates that the image cache is always retained.

You can set this parameter to LRU, which indicates that the image cache can be automatically deleted. When the number of image caches reaches the quota limit, the system automatically deletes the image caches that are least recently used and have EliminationStrategy set to LRU.

parameters.name: Flash
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the instant image cache feature. If you enable this feature, the creation of the image cache is accelerated. Valid values:

- true

- false

Default value: false.

parameters.name: FlashCopyCount
parameters.description:
The number of local snapshot replicas. By default, one image cache corresponds to one snapshot. If the image cache is used to create multiple ECI instances in a batch, create multiple snapshot replicas. Add one snapshot replica for every 1,000 ECI instances.

> If the instant image cache feature is enabled (Flash is set to true), local snapshots are first created during the image cache creation process. After the local snapshots are created, standard snapshots are created. After the standard snapshots are created, the local snapshots are automatically deleted.

parameters.name: Image
parameters.description: The container images used to create the image cache.

parameters.name: ImageCacheName
parameters.description: The name of the image cache.

parameters.name: ImageCacheSize
parameters.description: The size of the image cache. The default value is 20 GiB.

parameters.name: ImageRegistryCredential
parameters.description: The credentials of the image repository.

sub_parameters.name: Password
sub_parameters.description: The password for the image repository.

sub_parameters.name: Server
sub_parameters.description: The address of the image repository. Do not include the `http://` or `https://` prefix.

sub_parameters.name: UserName
sub_parameters.description: The username for the image repository.

parameters.name: InsecureRegistry
parameters.description:
The address of a self-managed image repository.

When you create an image cache using an image from a self-managed image repository that uses a self-signed certificate, set this parameter to skip certificate verification. This prevents image pull failures caused by certificate verification failures.

parameters.name: OsType
parameters.description:
The operating system of the container image. Valid values:

- Linux (default)

- Windows

> Windows is in invitational preview. To use this feature, submit a ticket.

parameters.name: PlainHttpRegistry
parameters.description: The address of a self-managed image repository. When you create an image cache using an image from a self-managed image repository that uses the HTTP protocol, set this parameter to allow ECI to pull the image over HTTP. This prevents image pull failures caused by protocol mismatch.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: RetentionDays
parameters.description:
The retention period of the image cache. The image cache is cleared after the retention period expires. By default, the image cache never expires.

> An image cache that fails to be created is retained for only one day.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group.

parameters.name: StandardCopyCount
parameters.description:
The number of standard snapshot replicas. By default, one image cache corresponds to one snapshot. If the image cache is used to create multiple ECI instances in a batch, create multiple snapshot replicas. Add one snapshot replica for every 1,000 ECI instances.

> If the instant image cache feature is disabled (Flash is set to false), only standard snapshots are created during the image cache creation process.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the image cache. You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the image cache tag.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the image cache tag.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch. You can specify up to 10 vSwitch IDs, separated by commas (,). For example, `vsw-***,vsw-***`.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone.
